harnesses.name: source_paths::proofs::tracked_path_records_are_bounded
harnesses.contract: Each byte transition respects record, path, count, and aggregate budgets and reports malformed record endings.
harnesses.input_domain: Every byte and all admitted usize counters: total bytes through 16877216, records through 100000, record bytes through 4096, and aggregate path bytes through 16777216.
harnesses.bound: Scalar per-byte transition with explicit admitted-counter assumptions; no complete UTF-8 or arbitrary-length parser claim.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths.rs PathBudget::advance and PathBudget::finish called by tracked_paths before portable-path construction

harnesses.name: source_paths::proofs::repository_metadata_is_excluded
harnesses.contract: Every listed repository-metadata component is excluded at root and nested positions while an ordinary path is admitted.
harnesses.input_domain: All sixteen fixed root/nested paths for the eight metadata names and both metadata/ordinary control values.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; finite path fixtures, not all Unicode path strings or filesystem semantics.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths.rs metadata_path and metadata_component delegate to the production source_paths/metadata.rs classifier and scanner used by tracked_paths and the native ignore walker

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::execution_records_preserve_command_outcomes
harnesses.contract: Recorded command completion preserves the exact exit code or launch failure and rejects unfinished or supervisor-only outcomes.
harnesses.input_domain: Every i32 exit code and all modeled job outcomes; one valid launch-error payload.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; strings are the fixed one-byte payload.

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::resource_budget_is_bounded
harnesses.contract: Admission accepts exactly the configured concurrent-job, memory, and swap bounds.
harnesses.input_domain: All u32 concurrent counts and all u64 memory quantities.

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::job_transitions_preserve_queue_and_terminal_invariants
harnesses.contract: Valid transitions preserve phase, PID, and outcomes; invalid transitions leave the state unchanged.
harnesses.input_domain: All modeled phases/events, all u32 input PIDs, all i32 exit codes; representative nonzero previous PID and one-byte launch reason.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; finite phase construction, fixed reason payload.

harnesses.name: job_protocol::proofs::persistent_jobs_survive_client_actions
harnesses.contract: Disconnect preserves durable state, retries are idempotent, conflicts are rejected, and only active jobs can be reaped.
harnesses.input_domain: Every projection of the five recorded phases, all four durable states, and every action, including both request-equivalence values.
harnesses.bound: No loops or assumptions; complete finite enum domain.

boundaries.reason: The source-bound scalar budget and finite metadata proofs do not establish native Git index output, filesystem identity and concurrent mutation, capability-relative file opening, Windows reparse semantics, or tar publication. The actual source adapter merges validated tracked paths with the existing ignore walker and passes one retained root capability to archive admission.
boundaries.evidence: Native source::tests on Mac, Linux and Windows check repository/global ignored tracked modified bytes, untracked ignored exclusion, tracked deletion and metadata exclusion, subdirectory-relative paths, unchanged non-Git behavior, and linked-directory containment. The global-ignore fixture creates its actual configuration with git config --file arguments; the Windows containment fixture uses a real junction. Native source_paths::tests cover actual UTF-8/portable parsing and all record/count/aggregate byte boundaries, and the source_paths corpus replays the production parser and round trip. Both runtime and build-time archives use the capability-relative Archive::add path.
boundaries.reconsider: Git output or capability/filesystem semantics change, a native source, link, budget, collision or archive contract fails, or a verifier can check the actual Git/filesystem adapter boundary.

boundaries.reason: The finite protocol step and job-state proofs do not establish filesystem locking, worker creation, SSH reliability, or native process lifetime.
boundaries.evidence: Native workspace tests exercise duplicate and conflicting submission, the existing launch-lock boundary, finished-job retries, launch refusal, and missing-supervisor state through the production app and Store adapters.
boundaries.reconsider: The launch or store locking protocol changes, a native adapter contract fails, or a verifier supports the actual filesystem and process boundary.

boundaries.reason: The supported native Kani, Quint/Apalache, Miri, and libFuzzer owner lane runs on Linux and Mac; native Windows verifier capability is not claimed.
boundaries.evidence: Linux or Mac: mise run verify and mise run miri on the exact source digest; Windows: cargo xtask verify inventory, cargo xtask windows-contracts, and mise run test for native SDK, process ownership, and filesystem contracts.
boundaries.reconsider: A pinned native verifier supports Windows, the implementation adds target-specific core decisions, or any native Windows contract fails.

boundaries.reason: Kani does not establish concurrent Win32 kernel ownership or foreign-function behavior.
boundaries.evidence: mise x -- cargo xtask windows-contracts; mise run test on Windows exercises capability, child ownership, failure cleanup, and process-tree termination.
boundaries.reconsider: A verifier supports the actual Win32 boundary, SDK semantics change, or a native ownership contract fails.
